note: Floors are per split, in execution accuracy percent, taken as the minimum observed across the recent runs on Mini-Dev (G 9120c2b, H d5927b0, I 700529b, J 4ad0181, and 1.0.0 run 39762058351), applied to the full 500-question split since run 39776718012. A rerun may land below a floor by tolerancePp before the gate fails, because ADR-166 measured that anything inside 4pp cannot be separated from sampling noise at n=239. `inline+retrieval` and `inline+icl` were added to the chain after those runs and have no floors yet: the gate records its first measurement and says so rather than inventing a threshold. A run scored on fewer than 95% of the baseline sample fails as a changed sample rather than as a regression.
